description: This file declares the implementation of an IPC channel class (`ChannelImpl`) and a factory class (`ChannelFactory`) for inter-process communication within the Rialto project. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and external dependencies related to protobuf messaging, socket communication, and event handling.

classes.name: ChannelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IPC channels, either from a socket file descriptor or a socket path.

classes.name: ChannelImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the IChannel interface, managing socket communication, message processing, and event handling for IPC.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a new IChannel instance from a socket file descriptor or socket path.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the channel is currently connected.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for socket events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from an event by its tag.

methods.name: CallMethod
methods.description: Invokes a remote method via protobuf descriptors.

methods.name: subscribeImpl
methods.description: Subscribes to an event with a handler.
